ValidationRule.description: Communication Preferences multi-picklist field: If Email is selected, Email field must be populated. If Phone is selected, one of the 3 phone fields must be populated. If Text is selected, the Mobile Phone field must be populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( INCLUDES( Communication_Preference__c , "Email") && ISBLANK( Email ) || INCLUDES( Communication_Preference__c , "Text") && ISBLANK( MobilePhone ) || (INCLUDES( Communication_Preference__c , "Phone") && (ISBLANK( MobilePhone )) && (ISBLANK( OtherPhone )) && (ISBLANK( HomePhone ))) ) && $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Email field must be populated if "Email" is selected. One of the phone fields must be populated if "Phone" is selected. The Mobile Phone field must be populated if "Text" is selected.
